title: The Woman from Shunem Returns
description: Elisha warns the woman from Shunem, whose son he had raised from the dead, about a seven-year famine, and she moves with her household to the land of the Philistines. When the seven years are over, she returns and goes to the king to get back her house and field. At that very moment, Gehazi, Elisha's servant, tells the king how the prophet raised the dead boy to life, and the woman herself comes in to present her case. The king orders that she be restored all her property and the produce of the field from the seven years she was away.
